name: Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 32.65, price over EPS 17.38); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 208.31 percent a year from FY2021 (860000) to FY2025 (7.77e+07), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 1.12251e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (TradingView scanner (total_shares_outstanding); price 2.26 EGP)
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the total-equity row the P/B divides is an order of magnitude from its own adjacent year (FY2025 8.8717e+08 against FY2024 7.845e+07), so the book value for FY2025 is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
